Callout.Name: Lost Walker
Callout.Message: Walker on the phone and lost, battery nearly flat.
Callout.Advisory: Knows the trailhead, does not know where they are.

Script.Line: I am on a path but I do not know which one.
I can see a ridge to my left and water below it.
My battery is nearly gone. I am going to have to stop talking.

Lines.Approach: They are on the phone and the battery is going. We have a trailhead and nothing else.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
